# Aurex Documentation Map (/llms.txt)

> Aurex is an in-process Python (`aurex-sdk`) and Node.js (`aurex-sdk`) FinOps SDK that stops LLM token waste across one continuous 3-stage pipeline: **Before the Call (Prefix & 200k Cliff Shield)** -> **During the Call (Session, Thinking & Stream Circuit Breaker)** -> **After the Call + CI (Outcome Cost & Soft-Failure Gate)**. Zero proxy latency, zero raw prompt PII transmitted by default.

## Core Documentation Routes

- `/docs` — Overview: 3-stage call lifecycle, 60-second Python/Node quickstart, and architecture summary.
- `/docs/installation` — Quickstart & Installation: `pip install aurex-sdk` / `npm install aurex-sdk`, `patch_all()` / `patchAll()`, zero-code `aurex install-hook`, and cloud sync setup.
- `/docs/stage-1-shield` — Stage 1 (Before the Call): Prefix Cache-Shield, deterministic JSON canonicalization, `>5m` Anthropic cache-TTL gap warnings, and `>200k` 2x context cliff protection.
- `/docs/stage-2-breaker` — Stage 2 (During the Call): Session isolation (`workflow_id` / OpenTelemetry `trace_id`), Redis multi-worker budgets, `max_thinking_tokens` clamping, aborted-stream accounting, and `AurexBlocked` loop circuit breaking.
- `/docs/stage-3-outcomes` — Stage 3 (After the Call + CI): `mark_success()` / `mark_failure()`, HTTP-200 soft-failure detection (`grammar_loop`, `thinking_exhausted` -> `unfulfilled_spend`), tenant margin guardrails (`/api/v1/policies`), and `aurex ci --baseline` PR diffs.
- `/docs/reference` — Config & Provider Reference: `AurexConfig`, `BudgetGuard`, environment variables, and supported providers (OpenAI Chat + `responses.create`, Groq/Together/Fireworks/OpenRouter, Anthropic, Google Gemini, LiteLLM, local Ollama).

## Canonical Quickstart (Python)

```python
from aurex_sdk import AurexAuditor, AurexConfig, patch_all

auditor = AurexAuditor(
    AurexConfig(
        budget_guard={"max_cost_per_session": 1.00, "max_thinking_tokens": 4096, "on_budget_exceeded": "throw"},
        enable_loop_guard=True,
    )
)
patch_all(auditor)
# Make standard OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / LiteLLM calls...
auditor.mark_success("workflow-123")
auditor.flush()
```

## Canonical Quickstart (Node.js / TypeScript)

```typescript
import { AurexAuditor } from "aurex-sdk";

const auditor = AurexAuditor.getInstance({
  budgetGuard: { maxCostPerSession: 1.0, maxThinkingTokens: 4096, onBudgetExceeded: "throw" },
  enableLoopGuard: true,
});
auditor.patchAll();
// Make standard OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / LiteLLM calls...
auditor.markSuccess("workflow-123");
auditor.flush();
```
